defense.opener: Hi, I'm Mathilda. If you already have a solution, send me all of it in one message. If not, feel free to start with an idea, or ask me for advice. You can also write your solution by hand and take photos of it, even with your phone. I'll turn them into text for you to check, and cut the drawings out myself. You can write formulas in plain text too, like x^2 or square root of 2, I'll understand them. I take a moment over each reply, so I don't give too much away or say something wrong 😇
